text:
erin: PulseCare asked for an Optimize pilot: console autosuggest for batching + cache TTLs, eval-triggered alerts, and a CSV export of recommended configs. They want pilot in ~6 weeks.

mike: Recommend MLP: deterministic batching heuristics (token-length buckets), simple prefix/KV cache toggles, and read-only eval alerts. Defer ML controller and quant recs to phase 2.

yu: Customer targets? latency SLOs and exact quality metric? Also need sample traffic and ~1k eval labels or permission for sentinel probes.

erin: PulseCare: p95 < 310ms for short requests; alert if our entity-extraction F1 drops >3.2% vs baseline for 2 windows (window=600 reqs).

casey: Ops notes: pilot on Dedicated mixed GPUs; per-GPU batch ceilings needed; batching must keep p99 < 680ms. Need telemetry: batch_size_histogram, cache_hit_rate, eval_signal_count, and cost_delta estimate.

mike: Config sketch to expose in Console: buckets + max_batch + latency_cap_ms + cache.prefix_ttl_s. We'll also provide a CSV export: recommended params + estimated token savings and monthly cost delta.

infra-bot: Opening INF-5601 to add `optimize_v2` tag for eval signals. ETA 4d.

ops-bot: Runbook RUN-2302 stub created: acknowledge alert, run eval job, compare to baseline, notify model owner, flip batching to conservative mode if needed.

erin: Acceptance gates: (1) heuristic batching live + latency SLO visible, (2) cache toggles applied + token-savings measured, (3) eval-alerts surface in Console with signal breakdown, (4) CSV export of recommendations, (5) PulseCare sign-off on thresholds.

yu: Risk: noisy alerts if eval set small or traffic skewed. Mitigation: require human ack, set cool-down, and estimate expected false-positive rate in pilot doc.

erin: I'll ask PulseCare for traffic_profile.csv and eval_labels.csv and send pilot acceptance doc. mike, please draft the CSV schema and Console copy. Thanks. :thumbsup:
